notes: P1, Presidio north-west (2000 sheet p03). Road widths here: about 8-16 px between lines; wide paper read as land unless it is the bridge approach. Judgment calls: (1) The toll plaza paper (780-880, 810-940) and the wide band running SE from it between lines (880,980)-(1100,1205) and (915,980)-(1080,1095) (about 25 px) are taken as the bridge approach / Doyle Dr, street, not land: every road around opens into it and it is not enclosed by a looping road. (2) Lincoln Blvd: the arc lettered LINCOLN (770-860, 945-1160) ends at the approach's SW line at (855,950) and is read as passing under the approach; the short band lettered BLVD (870-920, 910-940) and the narrow band SE of it between (1000,1062) and (1000,1079) are read as Lincoln's continuation, street. (3) Limits that cut ink, not paper (a road closed off by a crossing line joins the lands on both sides through the ink): (850,957)-(864,944) across the approach line at Lincoln's mouth; (1117-1122, 1181-1191) across the line where a ramp's two arcs meet it. (4) Strokes along both lines of Lincoln at the LINCOLN lettering (768-819, 990-1068) and along the upper line of the BLVD band so the letters (which touch both lines) stay street and do not join the lands either side. (5) The NE line of the narrow road from (925,790) to (1010,880) is broken into dashes at (955-985, 805-835); taken as gaps in a solid line and closed with a stroke, not as a dashed (planned) road. (6) Limits across open road ends: the narrow road ending at (750,877) beside the toll structure; three line-ends at (905-934, 1153) north of the junction at (930,1200), read as two road stubs with a land wedge between them (wedge seeded open at (920,1160)); doubtful what they are; the hooked line-ends at (968-978, 1357); the mouth of the road leaving the fork at (1104,1206), limit to (1082,1232), which bounds the land wedge between the approach and the junction road. (7) Strokes on print gaps: (1092,1292)-(1089,1298); (929,811)-(920,813) where a line ends beside an arrowhead; (1186,1403)-(1191,1401) at a curl end. (8) The gore wedges and teardrops between diverging roads (1080,1128), (1150,1192), (1186,1245), (1193,1112), (1160,1110), (1154,989), (795,1125) are open land. (9) The ocean (top-left, west of the shoreline) is joined by the shoreline ink to the land west of the toll plaza and Road A: one open area. The toll canopy outline across the approach at (750-805, 815-880) and the small outline between it and the narrow road (750-800, 850-925) are joined to that land through ink: labelled land. The sliver between the fork lines (1105-1170, 1210-1280) is joined at the fork to the land wedge west of it. Unseeded islands left: lettering LINCOLN (787,1029) and (585,1449), BLVD (886,930), the arrowhead at (845,879), and a lone line between two roads at (907,815); all street.
